race.comment: SHE'S AN ARTIST (13) comes to hand quickly and strong through the line first up with the 59.5kg when third over 1100m at Rosehill in BM78 class. Proven at this level and drops in weight with the key jockey change. HAWKER HALL (1) smart on pace sprinter kept fresh for this. Struggled to see the 1200m out second up when fourth at Rosehill five weeks ago. Back to his pet trip and gets plenty of favours from the gate. Sure to be thereabouts. AMAZING EAGLE (17) win record hardly excites and returns from a let-up. Gets the right set-up after motoring late first up to run second over 1000m at this track. Has genuine claims if he gains a start. HIDDEN MOTIVE (4) frustrating sprinter resuming. Placed in the Listed Fireball over this track and trip when resuming last March. Stays in the mix.
